description: The Ashmand main text states a relational Part of Fortune procedure, while footnote 144 reports a Perugio Latin directional variant that counts from the Ascendant according to the Sun-Moon order.
why_they_differ: The main text gives the equal-relation and same-day/night procedure; the additional Perugio passage explicitly distinguishes forward counting when the Moon follows the Sun from reverse counting when it precedes the Sun.
user_facing_note: Disclose the selected Part of Fortune transmission and do not silently substitute one directional procedure for the other.
